class ModifEmail:
    """Generates HTML content for an updated analysis notification email."""

    def __init__(self, subject, sender, recipient, case, infos):
        self.subject = subject
        self.sender = sender
        self.recipient = recipient
        self.result = case.results
        self.infos = infos
        self.case = case

        self.cert_url = mail_config.get("security", "https://cert.example.com")
        self.cert_msg = mail_config.get("security_msg", "Report to CERT")

        self._extract_case_data()
        self._build_message()

    def _extract_case_data(self):
        self.type = "unknown"
        self.subjectMail = self.case.id
        self.senderMail = ""
        self.recipientMail = ""
        self.info = f"The analysis of the case: {self.subjectMail} has been updated."

        fm = self.case.fileOrMail
        nf = self.case.nonFileIocs

        if fm:
            if fm.mail:
                self.type = "e-mail"
                self.subjectMail = fm.mail.subject or self.case.id
                self.senderMail = fm.mail.reportedBy or "unknown"
                self.recipientMail = fm.mail.to or "unknown"
                self.info = (
                    f"The analysis of the case: {self.subjectMail}, "
                    f"FROM {self.senderMail} TO {self.recipientMail} has been updated:"
                )
            elif fm.file:
                self.type = "file"
                self.senderMail = fm.file.file_path.name
                self.info = (
                    f"The analysis of the case: {self.subjectMail}, "
                    f"for your file: {self.senderMail} has been updated:"
                )

        if nf:
            self.subjectMail = self.case.id
            if nf.ip:
                self.type = "ip"
                self.senderMail = nf.ip
                self.info = f"The analysis of the case: {self.subjectMail}, for your IP: {self.senderMail} has been updated:"
            elif nf.url:
                self.type = "url"
                self.senderMail = nf.url
                self.info = f"The analysis of the case: {self.subjectMail}, for your URL: {self.senderMail} has been updated:"
            elif nf.hash:
                self.type = "hash"
                self.senderMail = nf.hash
                self.info = f"The analysis of the case: {self.subjectMail}, for your HASH: {self.senderMail} has been updated:"

    def _build_message(self):
        base_style = "data-lineheight='1.5' style='line-height: 18px; text-align: center;'"
        self.dangertext = ""
        self.dangerDesc = ""

        result = self.result
        t = self.type

        if result == "Dangerous":
            self.dangertext = f"<div {base_style}>As a conclusion, this {t} has been revised as <strong style='color: rgb(255, 0, 0);'>dangerous*</strong>.</div>"
            if t == "e-mail":
                self.dangerDesc = (
                    "<div>To that extent, we ask you not to open a file or to click on a link or any item included in this e-mail. "
                    f"Please delete this e-mail and do not forward it. If you interacted with it, forward it to "
                    f"<a target='_blank' href='{self.cert_url}' style='color: rgb(0, 187, 221); text-decoration: none;'>{self.cert_msg}</a> "
                    "with details of your interaction.</div><div><br></div>"
                )
            else:
                self.dangerDesc = "<div>To that extent, we ask you not to open a file or to click on a link or any item.</div>"

        elif result == "Inconclusive":
            self.dangertext = f"<div {base_style}>As a conclusion, this {t} has been revised as <strong style='color: rgb(0, 164, 233);'>inconclusive*</strong>.</div>"
            self.dangerDesc = (
                "<div>As a precaution, we ask you not to open a file or to click on a link"
                f"{' included in this e-mail' if t == 'e-mail' else ''}.</div><div><br></div>"
            )

        elif result == "Suspicious":
            self.dangertext = f"<div {base_style}>As a conclusion, this {t} has been revised as most <strong style='color: rgb(255, 154, 0);'>likely suspicious*</strong>.</div>"
            self.dangerDesc = (
                "<div>As a precaution, we ask you not to open a file or to click on a link"
                f"{' included in this e-mail' if t == 'e-mail' else ''}.</div><div><br></div>"
            )

        elif result == "Safe":
            self.dangertext = f"<div {base_style}>As a conclusion, this {t} has been revised as most <strong style='color: rgb(94, 194, 127);'>likely safe*</strong>.</div>"
            self.dangerDesc = (
                f"<div>To that extent, feel free to proceed with your {t} and remain vigilant regarding potential new communications.</div>"
            )

    def _html_footer_end(self):
        return """
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </table>
  </body>
</html>
"""

    def _html_table(self):
        html = self._logo_table()
        html += self._type_mail_table()
        html += self._body_table()
        html += self._html_footer_start()
        html += self._html_team_table()
        html += self._html_footer_global()
        html += self._html_social_media()
        html += self._html_footer_end()
        return html



[docs]
    def send(self):
        """
        Send the email using the SMTP server.
        """
        msg = MIMEMultipart()
        msg['From'] = self.sender
        if self.infos != "":
            msg['To'] = str(self.infos)
        else:
            msg['To'] = str(self.recipient)
        msg['Subject'] = str(self.subject)
        # Attach the HTML content to the email
        html_content = self._html_table()
        msg.attach(MIMEText(html_content, 'html'))

        # Connect to the SMTP server
        server = smtplib.SMTP(mail_config.get("server"), mail_config.get("port", 587))
        # Send the email
        text = msg.as_string()
        server.sendmail(self.sender, str(self.recipient), text)

        # Close the connection
        server.quit()
